items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And then he and Jay Shambin, I think it was you, Lamar, they went to... The Loyola School of Music band... ctx.x: Did he play with Schilling? Is that the guy? Maybe. Same time Dan Taggart did. I think I saw his picture in this book. Yeah.

So what I'm saying? He was a real fine old teacher. A lot of patience. And sometimes Farsola would get stuck, and he'd just hold his hand on his lap. The whole hour he says, okay Fars, if you didn't want to study, if you have hours up you can go. I'm going to have to leave him out of nowhere. He just wouldn't budge. And all of a sudden, about a year after, he went through, you see about three of these here, books. Is it like a method? Yeah. See, three methods inside of a year. He completed that and he was, I mean…
